description: Cloudflare WAF and Edge Security Ruleset for Elsewedy University of Technology Portal

rules.name: SQL Injection (SQLi) Detection - Restrict Unparameterized Constructs
Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Detection - Filter Script Tags and Events

custom_waf_rules.name: Protect Admin Health Endpoint
custom_waf_rules.description: Issue challenge to any unauthenticated probe directed at deep health diagnostic endpoint

custom_waf_rules.name: Auth Endpoint Rate Limit and Challenge
custom_waf_rules.description: Challenge suspicious requests on login and authentication routes

custom_waf_rules.name: Block Malicious User Agents
custom_waf_rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap" or http.user_agent contains "nikto" or http.user_agent contains "gobuster" or http.user_agent contains "nmap")
custom_waf_rules.description: Instantly block automated attack scanners and penetration tools
